review_type: Installed governance interpretation; not contract Mode A, implementation Mode B, or QA.
decision_scope: Whether high-risk F1/F2 Loop 2 implementation may start under the observed failed operational preflight, including code intended only for a draft PR.

issues.finding: The mandatory operational capability preflight for the classified high-risk implementation is failed; an approved contract or draft-PR label does not discharge this separate pre-attempt gate.

required_fixes.action: Before Loop 2 source implementation, use a genuinely capable execution environment and capture a successful applicable high-risk capability preflight. Preserve the failed result and full role/contract gates. Do not remove the sandbox requirement, relabel the F1/F2 authority-verification repair, or count a mock result as operational success.

conclusion.planning_and_contract_preparation: A bounded proposal, independent contract review and a documented blocked implementation handoff can be prepared; those do not constitute implementation or runtime qualification. A docs/contract-only draft must state that no fixes have been implemented.
conclusion.remaining_qualification: A successful preflight would only permit progression; independent Mode B, QA, convergent review or the isolation suite, and evidence capture remain required.
conclusion.rule_interpretation_limit: The installed text requires preflight before governed attempts and makes it an additional high-risk gate. It does not contain a literal draft-PR exemption. This disposition applies those rules; it does not claim that the CLI mechanically prevents every file write or that an isolation breach already occurred merely because a probe failed.
conclusion.probe_vs_repair: A diagnostic probe cannot deliver an uncounted repair. Calling an implementation draft, demonstration or probe does not supply an exemption.
conclusion.qualified_field_limit: The observed qualified=true derives from recorded feature-list completion, whereas operational sandbox readiness is false. It is not a pass for this actual runtime probe.
conclusion.scope: F1 approved-contract context at done and F2 detection of changed same-status preexisting dirty files only; F3/F4 proof-binding gaps remain excluded and open.

additional_rule_refs.purpose: Installed governance takes precedence over authored framework product.
Preflight before governed attempts; installed payload must remain unchanged.
High-assurance role separation and capability gates.
Attempt and probe distinction; infrastructure failure remains a failure.
Actual isolation or authority invariant breach requires a hard stop; no unilateral continuation.
qualified field is computed separately from runtime operational readiness.

limitations: No independent preflight rerun was needed for this read-only rule interpretation.
No product, contract, installed governance or lifecycle-state fields were edited.
This is not a machine approval of a yet-unreviewed contract.
